title: Zumba® Latin Easy-To-Follow Basic Steps Tutorial for Beginners

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The lead instructor guides two beginners through fundamental Latin dance steps with energetic encouragement and clear verbal cues. The instruction combines step-by-step breakdowns with ongoing body movement guidance.

lesson_structure.note: Instructors introduce themselves and welcome beginners to the basic steps tutorial.
Teacher introduces the first rhythm, Cumbia, and explains the basic bounce and footwork.
Teacher leads Cumbia basic steps and variations with counting and arm movements.
Teacher introduces Merengue rhythm with marching in place.
Teacher demonstrates Merengue march and 6-count variations with partner.
Teacher transitions to Salsa rhythm, introducing the basic tap and front-and-back steps.

metaphors: like when you're cooking and your food needs that little extra seasoning
common_mistakes: Not relaxing the upper body or back foot during Cumbia and Merengue
safety: Relax your body and let loose

steps_taught.name: Cumbia Two-Step
steps_taught.description: Stepping in place with a slight back foot bend and bounce.

steps_taught.name: Cumbia Front and Back
steps_taught.description: Stepping forward and backward with alternating foot taps.

steps_taught.name: Merengue March
steps_taught.description: Marching in place while letting the upper body sway.

steps_taught.name: Merengue Six-Count
steps_taught.description: Side-to-side steps counted up to six with arm movements.

steps_taught.name: Salsa Front and Back
steps_taught.description: Stepping front and back with simple weight shifts.

what_hinders: Limited back or side angles for footwork clarity

quotes.text: If you're a beginner and have been nervous to try a live class, you've come to the right place.
Now, I want you to relax your body and let loose.
Salsa, it's all about passion. It's about feeling it.

evidence_segments.observation: Two instructors standing side by side in a white studio setting, welcoming the viewer.
Instructor demonstrates a Cumbia basic step while explaining the foot bounce.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact weight distribution details on feet

extraction.distinctive_method: Using food seasoning as a metaphor for adding stylistic flair and expression to basic Latin rhythms.
